summary: The ansible-navigator run subcommand settings include help-playbook (--hp), inventory (-i), inventory-column (--ic), playbook (positional) and playbook-artifact-enable (--pae, default True), which is not compatible with --mode stdout when playbooks need user input.
questions: What options does ansible-navigator run accept?
How do I disable playbook artifacts in ansible-navigator?
Why does ansible-navigator run fail with prompts in stdout mode?
